english.title: Fail to notify a local authority of the intended demolition of building or part of building
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) began the demolition of

(A)_[a building,]_
(B)_[part of a building,]

namely **(..SPECIFY BUILDING AND PART IF APPLICABLE..), to which section 80 of the Building Act 1984 applied without giving the local authority notice of your intention to do so and without

(C)_[that authority having given a notice to you under section 81 of the Act]_
(D)_[the relevant period having expired]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 80(4) of the Building Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

english.notes:
(i) See section 80(1) for exceptions to buildings to which the section applies
(ii) 'Relevant period' is defined in section 81
